title: 高盛Ian Draiden：AI资本开支周期，如何重塑亚洲融资市场？
speaker: Ian Draiden

segments.en: We've seen elevated issuance activity across the region really but particularly in those economies those markets that are indexed to the AI capex super cycle.
segments.zh: 整个地区都出现了活跃的发行活动，尤其是那些与AI资本开支超级周期紧密相关的经济体和市场。

segments.en: Central to all of that of course is capital formation. So Japan, Korea, China, Taiwan, across the value chain, we've seen a lot of companies coming to market so far this year.
segments.zh: 核心当然是资本形成。日本、韩国、中国、台湾，整个产业链上，今年已有大量企业进入市场。

segments.en: Predominantly so you know think about Korea SK high necks in China we've seen Zhengji in a light for example luck share. There's a bunch of stuff coming out of Taiwan as well. And so yeah a predominantly not exclusively but predominantly tech related.
segments.zh: 主要是科技相关，比如韩国的SK海力士，中国的正基、光迅等。台湾也有不少项目。所以是的，主要是科技相关，虽然不是全部，但占主导。

segments.en: And how much racing from the client side in terms of interest investor participation in a lot of the listings especially dollar investors looking at Hong Kong and all the raised fundraising that's going on here. There's been a sea change so you've probably discussed this on this program before but the deep-seek moment at the start of last year.
segments.zh: 客户端的参与热情如何，尤其是美元投资者关注香港市场以及这里的融资活动。已经发生了根本性变化，你们节目可能讨论过，去年初的DeepSeek时刻。

segments.en: I think really alerted global investors particularly long-only investors to China's technological ascendancy. Okay, number one number two global investors long-only's were underweight Chinese equities from about 2022. And number three valuations were quite compelling and so if you package those three things notwithstanding the complicated operating environments. We've seen participation are reweighting into China in size.
segments.zh: 我认为这真正让全球投资者，尤其是长线投资者，注意到中国技术的崛起。第二，全球长线投资者从2022年左右开始低配中国权益资产。第三，估值相当有吸引力。把这三点结合起来，尽管经营环境复杂，我们看到资金正在大规模重新配置到中国。
